load_pattern: P-and-ID channel mapping and facility commissioning review
repetition: review once and repeat after hardware revision
observable: actual process topology and existence of candidate channels
acceptance_gate: Facility engineer confirms topology calibration and safety authorization before any energized experiment
notes: No laboratory operation scheduled by this desk protocol

load_pattern: clock calibration and sensor response/traceability mapping
observable: clock offset latency sensor lag calibration and uncertainty documents
acceptance_gate: Document independent clock verification and time lag; no inferred dynamics from unsynchronized signals
notes: Cannot assign sampling period without actual sensor bandwidth

load_pattern: repeat nominal safe steady operating point
repetition: three independent repeat visits proposed; requires facility approval
observable: gas source enthalpy wall and CO2 heater and sink duty
acceptance_gate: Document stability criteria and closures with calibrated sensor covariance before accepting nominal baseline
notes: No nominal temperature pressure flow or duration is authorized

repetition: repeat for independent groups; requested amplitudes TBD
observable: gas-wall effectiveness local wall gradients and gas cp dependence
acceptance_gate: Holdout groups must not contribute to fitting; report property ranges and constraints
notes: No rig envelope asserted; supervisor defines permitted points

load_pattern: measure bypass branch split and mixing
observable: actual mass fraction vs command and branch flow
acceptance_gate: Measured source mass and sensible enthalpy closure using both active and mixed exhaust
notes: No valve mass fraction identification from command alone

repetition: at least two repeat steps per approved amplitude
observable: wall time constant and sign; thermal transient residual
acceptance_gate: Repeatability time-synchronization and identifiable response must pass before model fitting
notes: No step amplitude timing or test authorization specified

repetition: repeat at distinct approved baseline points
observable: gas flow dependence of heat transfer and hydraulic response
acceptance_gate: Mass and energy conservation lag and source pressure-loss sign
notes: Do not assume gas UA fixed under changing flow

load_pattern: bounded bypass command step and release
repetition: repeat command up/down at approved baselines
observable: actuator rate deadband hysteresis and actual branch flow
acceptance_gate: Command versus measured mass fraction; integrated gas enthalpy mixing closure
notes: Not authorized to bypass plant safety controls

observable: delayed wall response and quasi-steady power block departures
acceptance_gate: Compare step and ramp on separately declared test sets; retain all exclusions
notes: Ramp slope and actuator constraints require facility sign-off

repetition: design excitation amplitudes after safety analysis
observable: local response function and parameter sensitivity
acceptance_gate: Demonstrate signal above measurement uncertainty without approaching physical limits
notes: No automatic high frequency excitation; sensor bandwidth TBD

load_pattern: fixed bypass versus approved closed-loop setpoint tracking
repetition: paired randomized or counterbalanced test order if authorized
observable: temperature RMSE source utilization valve effort and net energy tradeoff
acceptance_gate: Use identical source disturbance bounds and independent validation groups; log all rejects
notes: WP3 software PI is not automatically approved for rig control

repetition: multiple full run groups sealed before parameter fitting
observable: unseen model prediction intervals energy balance and controller metrics
acceptance_gate: No refit from heldout groups; publish coverage model errors and failure counts
notes: Blind validation conditional on facility instrumentation availability

load_pattern: passive operational safety and emergency event log audit
repetition: audit logs only with facility permission
observable: trigger traces and fail-safe response timestamps
acceptance_gate: Review safety team approval; no deliberately induced trip from this protocol
notes: Safety interlocks remain plant authority; research tool must be read-only
